data.explanation: This is a quote request, not an invoice: no payment is due yet. The firm wants to know whether you want them to carry out the basement-moisture assessment. The letter's own offer is attached separately and is not included in this text. Reply by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the stated working-day period (counting Monday to Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays) from the letter's date. The letter does not say what happens if you miss this date, but the quote may simply expire or need to be reconfirmed. If you want the report, just confirm; otherwise let them know you decline.
